instruction: Configure GIMP to show the grid by default when opening images.

metadata.explanation: This task requires enabling the grid display in GIMP. The evaluator checks the sessionrc config file for 'show-grid yes' setting using the existing check_config_status metric. Similar complexity to original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads GIMP sessionrc config file which stores grid display settings
Metric correctly parses GIMP config format and checks for 'show-grid yes' key-value pair
Expected rule correctly specifies the setting that enables grid display by default
Postconfig appropriately closes GIMP (Ctrl+Q) to trigger saving of settings to sessionrc
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (show grid by default) and evaluator checks that requirement
Parameter handling is correct: metric receives rules dict directly and accesses rule['key'] and rule['value'] without incorrectly trying to access rule['rules']
